ingredients:
Chocolate Cookie: Enriched Wheat Flour (Wheat Flour, Niacin, Reduced Iron, Thiamine Mononitrate, Riboflavin, Folic Acid), Sugar, Palm Oil, Invert Sugar, Cocoa Processed With Alkali, Baking Soda, Natural & Artificial Flavors, Salt, Soy Lecithin As An Emulsifier, Eggs, Whey Powder (Milk).

Icing: Powdered Sugar (Sugar, Cornstarch), Water, Palm Oil And/Or Modified Palm Oil, Corn Syrup, Modified Corn Starch, Salt, Artificial Flavors, Mono- And Diglycerides, Citric Acid, Polysorbate 60, Titanium Dioxide, Potassium Sorbate (Preservative), Mixed Tocopherols, Ascorbyl Palmitate, Natural Flavor.

Starburst® Minis: Sugar, Corn Syrup, Palm Oil, Less Than 2% Of: Citric Acid, Pectin, Sodium Citrate, Apple Juice From Concentrate, Natural And Artificial Flavors, Mono- And Diglycerides, Confectioner's Glaze, Colors (Yellow 6, Red 40, Yellow 5, Blue 1), Carnauba Wax.

Candy Jewels: Dextrose, Corn Syrup, Citric Acid, Calcium Stearate, Tapioca Dextrin, Confectioner's Glaze, Carnauba Wax, Artificial Flavors, Red 3, Red 40, Yellow 5, Blue 1.
